content:
Yesterday in the 1st Plenary of the International Conference on "Peace Mediation and Rule of Law" at The Lalit Hotel, Jaipur, Sri Tushar Mehta Learned Solicitor General of India made an important observation.

He said that in order to make mediation successful, its implementation by the Government parties, particularly by the officer responsible for relief claimed by the Claimant party, has to be taken care of. 

He said that while training officials in Mediation is an obvious step, the governments need to frame guidelines so that officers feel confident in taking onus in mediation proceedings and a mediated outcome is complied with.

This will be an important development in the Journey of Mediation as a means of primary Justice Delivery System.
comment: The key challenge may be less about awareness and more about institutional incentives—officials need clear authority and protection so settlement decisions are not viewed as personal risk.
